headline: Nucleic acid foundation models are tailored to taxa, RNA classes and controllable design tasks
label: Specialized Nucleic Acid Foundation Models
summary: New preprints and papers pair pretrained nucleotide models with domain corpora, mechanistic priors and steering for regulatory DNA, ncRNA, lncRNA and codon design.
synthesis: The common thread is specialization of nucleotide foundation models beyond generic embeddings. GPN is pretrained on 455 apicomplexan assemblies to improve epigenomic prediction in P. falciparum. B-RANKO (150M parameters, bidirectional decoder-only) targets ncRNA generation and representation, and LncRFM contributes LncCorpus and LncBench for lncRNA prediction, reporting gains over RNA foundation models. MARRI adds opening penalties and hybridization gains to cross-RNA attention for RNA-RNA interactions. A second strand concerns controllable generation: GENECraft couples a genomic language model with a functional oracle without training, ARCADE steers activations to control CAI, minimum free energy and GC content, and GenNA conditions generation on natural-language annotations across 2221 eukaryotic species. The items differ in task and architecture, but converge on domain-matched data and explicit control.
